name: wiro-ai
title: Wiro AI
description: Generate images, video, speech and music, chat with LLMs, run workflows and agents, and search 1,000+ AI models on Wiro AI.
author: wiroai

commands.name: generate-image
commands.title: Generate Image
commands.subtitle: Wiro AI
commands.description: Pick a Wiro AI image model, write a prompt and get the image to copy, save or preview.

commands.name: edit-image
commands.title: Edit Image
commands.subtitle: Wiro AI
commands.description: Edit an image from Finder or the clipboard with a prompt, upscale it, remove its background or restore an old photo.

commands.name: generate-video
commands.title: Generate Video
commands.subtitle: Wiro AI
commands.description: Turn a prompt or an image into a video with a Wiro AI video model and follow its progress.

commands.name: generate-speech
commands.title: Generate Speech
commands.subtitle: Wiro AI
commands.description: Read the selected text aloud with a Wiro AI text-to-speech model and the voice you pick.

commands.name: generate-music
commands.title: Generate Music
commands.subtitle: Wiro AI
commands.description: Make music or a song from a prompt with a Wiro AI music model.

commands.name: transcribe-audio
commands.title: Transcribe Audio
commands.subtitle: Wiro AI
commands.description: Turn an audio file into text with a Wiro AI speech-to-text model.

commands.name: ask-ai
commands.title: Ask AI
commands.subtitle: Wiro AI
commands.description: Chat with GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok and other LLMs through the Wiro AI LLM gateway.

commands.name: search-models
commands.title: Search Models
commands.subtitle: Wiro AI
commands.description: Search the Wiro AI model catalog, see prices, open model pages and run models.

commands.name: run-model
commands.title: Run Any Model
commands.subtitle: Wiro AI
commands.description: Run any model in the Wiro AI catalog with a form built from its inputs.

commands.name: run-workflow
commands.title: Run Workflow
commands.subtitle: Wiro AI
commands.description: Run one of your Wiro AI workflows with its inputs and get its results.

commands.name: message-agent
commands.title: Message Agent
commands.subtitle: Wiro AI
commands.description: Message one of your deployed Wiro AI agents and read its replies.

commands.name: task-history
commands.title: Task History
commands.subtitle: Wiro AI
commands.description: See your recent Wiro AI tasks, their results and what they cost.

commands.name: wallet-balance
commands.title: Wallet Balance
commands.subtitle: Wiro AI
commands.description: Show your Wiro AI wallet balance in the menu bar.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: API key of your Wiro AI project. Create a project at wiro.ai/panel/project/new.

preferences.name: apiSecret
preferences.title: API Secret
preferences.description: API secret of the same project. Only needed when the project uses signature-based authentication.
preferences.placeholder: Leave empty for API Key Only projects

preferences.name: downloadDirectory
preferences.title: Save Folder
preferences.description: Where Save Image and Save Video put files. Your Downloads folder is used when this is empty.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
